source_chain.fact: Original public final service performs ClientCommands.publishingGetStatus with exact Space/object fields. Its existing catch returns nil for any native error whose code is null, regardless of description.
GetStatus.Response.Error.isNull is code == .null && description_p.isEmpty. Code zero with nonempty description is an error.

Original accepted GCD body marks native completion failed unless response.error.isNull, before throwing the original response error. The original Owner retains a failed mutation latch even if its UI body catches the error.
Pinned Heart PublishingGetStatus calls mapErrorCode(nil, errToCode(err, NULL)) and sends getErrorDescription(err) with the result.
mapErrorCode immediately returns zero when its first argument is nil. getErrorDescription returns an empty string only for nil error; otherwise it returns CleanupError(err).Error().
GetStatus forwards publishClientService.GetPublishStatus errors; a successful response is mapped to the actual Space/object publication.
The publishing client is pinned to v0.0.0-20260925080338-0fb960f00458.
ObjectPublishStatus queries the actual identity/Space/object. A missing object document produces publishapi.ErrNotFound.
ErrNotFound is the publisher-specific coded errors.New("not found"); UnwrapError maps that publisher code back to the same sentinel. Other publisher/transport errors are distinct.
GetPublishStatus invokes the original DRPC client and unwraps its error before returning.
CleanupError only changes file/URL/DNS/path-bearing errors; the literal not-found sentinel remains unchanged.

confirmed_source_defect: After a successful original unpublish mutation, a genuine absent status is .null plus description not found with no publish payload. The old generic Invocation marks that status admission failed before the service returns nil. Because the status read occurs within the registered mutation lineage, the Owner later refuses capture/save. Other code-zero descriptions also became nil in the original service, so a broad code-zero exception would falsely admit failures.

correction.unchanged_authority: Owner, lifetime, operation, InvocationDispatchBinding, admission, native completion/drain, account/source captures and named publish permission are unchanged.
